# dodopayments_meter (Data Source)

Reads one meter by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_meter" "example" {
  id = "<id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `aggregation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aggregation))
- `business_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `event_name` (String)
- `filter` (Attributes) A filter structure that combines multiple conditions with logical conjunctions (AND/OR).

Supports up to 3 levels of nesting to create complex filter expressions.
Each filter has a conjunction (and/or) and clauses that can be either direct conditions or nested filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `measurement_unit` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--aggregation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aggregation`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Required when type is not COUNT.
- `type` (String) Aggregation type for the meter.


<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Read-Only:
